subject: general
question: Each Gram Panchayat is represented by how many sarpanch?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Each Gram Panchayat is typically represented by one Sarpanch.
 
• The Sarpanch is the elected head of the Gram Panchayat.
 
• The Sarpanch plays a crucial role in local governance and administration in rural areas.
 
• The position of Sarpanch is a cornerstone of the Panchayati Raj system in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gram Panchayat**

 
 
• A Gram Panchayat is the basic unit of local administration in India, functioning at the village level.
 
• It consists of members elected by the village residents, with the Sarpanch serving as the head.
 
• The Gram Panchayat is responsible for implementing government schemes and addressing local issues.
 
 
 
• **Panchayati Raj System**
 
 
• The Panchayati Raj system is a decentralized form of government where each village or group of villages is governed by a Gram Panchayat.
 
• This system was formalized in India by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992.
 
• The goal of the Panchayati Raj is to empower local communities and promote participatory governance.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Sarpanch**
 
 
• The Sarpanch is responsible for calling and presiding over Gram Panchayat meetings.
 
• The Sarpanch ensures the execution of developmental projects and government schemes at the village level.
 
• The Sarpanch acts as a liaison between the village residents and higher levels of government.
